# VSSDK SDK-Style Conversion

## Preferences
- **Flow Mode**: Automatic
- **Target VSIX Project**: src/VisualStudio/Installer/OpenRiaServices.VisualStudio.Installer.csproj
- **Template Scope**: Update template projects under src/VisualStudio/Templates and src/VisualStudio/ItemTemplates that are packaged by the VSIX
- **Minimum Visual Studio Target**: Visual Studio 2022 (latest supported)

## Source Control
- **Source Branch**: copilot/modernize-test-projects-and-pipeline
- **Working Branch**: vssdk-sdk-style-conversion
- **Commit Strategy**: After Each Task
- **Branch Sync**: Auto (Merge)

## Key Decisions Log
